purpose: Every meaningful AUTOMATABLE failure observed across the Abu project, mapped to its regression test, its mutation proof (a deliberate defect the test catches), a deployed-path replay where applicable, and an evidence level. Replayed before every RC — failure coverage, not code coverage.
evidenceLevels: CODE < MOCK < BROWSER < PREVIEW < PHYSICAL_DEVICE < PRODUCTION

failures.symptom: A WhatsApp request whose body mentioned a meeting was routed to Calendar.
failures.rootCause: Intent detection keyed on calendar words in the body instead of the leading write/send verb.
failures.invariant: Explicit communication owns the turn; payload words never steal the outer action.
failures.regressionTest: src/screens/AbuAI/communicationMultiTurn.test.ts (calendar never activates; 'לא פגישה' does not inject פגישה)
failures.mutationProof: durabilityLaws-style: the test asserts createState.phase stays idle — a router that classified on body words goes red.
failures.prevention: Leading-verb anchoring in reduceGoal; single controller.

failures.symptom: Explicit send to an unresolved name fell to general chat.
failures.trigger: 'תשלח הודעה ללאה שיביא מחר שניצלים בערב' (לאה != stored לאו)
failures.rootCause: ownsStart guard required a resolved recipient; dropped to general when the name didn't resolve.
failures.invariant: Explicit communication never reaches general chat; payload preserved.
failures.regressionTest: communicationMultiTurn.test.ts ('an explicit send to an unresolved recipient stays communication')
failures.mutationProof: assert intent==='whatsapp' — the pre-fix guard goes red.

failures.symptom: Call request answered with a capability denial.
failures.rootCause: Provider prose denied a supported capability.
failures.invariant: Provider prose cannot deny a supported capability; no fabricated dial.
failures.mutationProof: injectedVoiceParity call variants assert kind==='call'.

failures.symptom: Message payload words changed the outer action / time.
failures.trigger: 'תכתבי למור שהפגישה מחר בשמונה וחצי בערב'
failures.rootCause: Body time/keywords leaked into outer intent.
failures.invariant: Outer action != inner payload; evening stays evening.
failures.regressionTest: communicationMultiTurn.test.ts (evening stays evening; message keeps facts)
failures.mutationProof: assert command.intent contains בערב/שמונה — leakage goes red.

failures.symptom: Bare follow-up spawned a calendar draft / lost the active message.
failures.rootCause: Follow-up not resolved against the pending communication goal.
failures.invariant: Follow-ups refine the SAME message; no calendar draft.
failures.mutationProof: assert createState.phase==='idle' across turns.

failures.symptom: Response said 'לחצי על התקשרי' but no usable button was visible.
failures.trigger: call handoff at a small iPhone viewport
failures.rootCause: Claim keyed on DOM presence, not geometry.
failures.invariant: 'לחצי/פתחי' only when the button is reachable (in-viewport, not obscured, >=44px).
failures.mutationProof: a below-the-fold button fails the bbox<=vh assertion.
failures.prevention: auto-scroll handoff card into view + geometry gate.

failures.symptom: Phone numbers gone after import + full close + reopen (names/photos survived).
failures.rootCause: Durable init was backend-authoritative and clobbered fresh localStorage with the stale seed (0.163). Fixed 0.164 (localStorage authoritative). NOT reproduced in-engine on 2 engines; residual is iOS storage partition/eviction.
failures.invariant: Once saved, phones survive terminate/reopen/upgrade on the same origin; no re-import.
failures.mutationProof: durableStore.test.ts clobber test goes red on a backend-authoritative reconcile.
failures.deployedReplay: e2e/persistence-lifecycle.spec.ts (Chromium + WebKit persistent profile, reopen x5) — PASS
failures.evidenceLevel: PREVIEW (2-engine); DEVICE confirmation pending for iOS partition
failures.prevention: localStorage-authoritative reconcile; D11 commit-before-success; storage taxonomy; enriched trace.

failures.symptom: Contacts absent after an RC update (each Preview URL = separate storage origin).
failures.trigger: opening a different *.vercel.app Preview than the one imported on
failures.rootCause: Per-origin storage; RC updates changed the origin.
failures.invariant: Stable origin persists across RC updates.
failures.mutationProof: classify on a non-canonical host returns WRONG_ORIGIN.

failures.symptom: A stale IndexedDB copy overwrote newer contacts on reopen.
failures.trigger: async backend not flushed before background; reopen reconcile
failures.rootCause: Reconcile treated backend as authoritative.
failures.invariant: A present, valid localStorage value wins; backend only recovers an evicted/corrupt key.
failures.mutationProof: reverting to backend-authoritative flips the clobber test red.

failures.symptom: UI showed 'saved' before the durable transaction committed (loss window).
failures.trigger: import -> immediate termination in the fire-and-forget window
failures.rootCause: durable.setString is async and was not awaited before success.
failures.invariant: D11 — success only after the durable transaction commits.
failures.mutationProof: delayed backend: backend not committed before flush (race observable); FIX awaits flush.
failures.prevention: ContactManagement handlers await durable.flush() before success + high-water marker.

failures.symptom: Resolver / Family Board rendered a stale snapshot after a write.
failures.trigger: save then read from a consumer holding an old array
failures.rootCause: Consumer cached a pre-write snapshot.
failures.invariant: D9 — resolver and Board reflect the same committed data.
failures.mutationProof: rendering the pre-write snapshot yields non-actionable while fresh is actionable.

failures.symptom: Recognizer ended early and lost speech / hung 'מקשיבה'.
failures.trigger: onend before finalize; iOS no-events hang
failures.rootCause: No restart/watchdog; interim not folded.
failures.invariant: Early onend restarts without loss; bounded watchdog.
failures.mutationProof: removing the restart makes the joined-transcript assertion red.

failures.symptom: Long message cut off on a natural pause.
failures.rootCause: Silence window too short for long mode.
failures.invariant: Short pause does not end; long silence finalizes.
failures.mutationProof: shrinking silenceMs finalizes mid-sentence — test red.

failures.symptom: Restart duplicated the prior segment.
failures.rootCause: Base not deduped across sessions.
failures.invariant: Joined, not duplicated.
failures.mutationProof: assert 'הודעה' appears once — a dup-append goes red.

failures.symptom: Valid JSON failed to parse on iPhone paste (BOM/zero-width/smart quotes/NBSP).
failures.rootCause: Raw paste contained invisible/typographic characters.
failures.invariant: Sanitize only invisible/typographic artifacts; data untouched; report changes.
failures.mutationProof: a smart-quote fixture parses after sanitize; disabling sanitize fails parse.

failures.symptom: WhatsApp button opened the JSON editor instead of the Family Board.
failures.rootCause: Setup/admin screen used as the default surface.
failures.invariant: WhatsApp button always opens the Family Board; admin is Settings-only.
failures.mutationProof: routing to setup fails the family-quick-faces visibility assertion.

failures.symptom: Product name inconsistent (הודעות vs Abu WhatsApp).
failures.rootCause: Multiple labels.
failures.invariant: Consistent 'Abu WhatsApp'.
failures.mutationProof: reverting a label fails the source assertion.

failures.symptom: Real provider prose contradicted the action status (blocked-provider tests missed it).
failures.rootCause: Only the deterministic path was tested.
failures.invariant: Real-provider prose cannot contradict ActionStatus.
failures.mutationProof: engine validateResponse rejects a contradicting draft.

failures.symptom: A storage/recovery failure was shown to the user as 'phone not configured'.
failures.rootCause: No error taxonomy; all missing data => 'not configured'.
failures.invariant: Distinct honest states; never 'not configured' for a storage failure.
failures.mutationProof: message table test: a failure code must not contain 'לא הוגדר'.

failures.symptom: A migration could strip/drop phones and commit the damage.
failures.rootCause: Migration mutated the live store without validation.
failures.invariant: D5 — migrate on a clone; commit only if schema+phone-preservation+checksum pass.
failures.mutationProof: strip-phones and drop-contact mutants abort with reason 'phone-loss'; prior intact.
